spans.text: At one time the Buddha was staying near Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.

entries.subject: wanderer Poṭṭhapāda
entries.object: residing together with three hundred wanderers in Mallikā’s single-halled monastery for philosophical debates

spans.text: Now at that time the wanderer Poṭṭhapāda was residing together with three hundred wanderers in Mallikā’s single-halled monastery for philosophical debates, hedged by pale-moon ebony trees.
Now at that time, Poṭṭhapāda was sitting together with a large assembly of wanderers making an uproar, a colossal racket.

entries.task_id: poṭṭhapāda|saw|the buddha coming off in the distance
entries.description: Poṭṭhapāda saw the Buddha coming off in the distance
entries.subject: Poṭṭhapāda
entries.object: the Buddha coming off in the distance

spans.text: Poṭṭhapāda saw the Buddha coming off in the distance, and hushed his own assembly, “Be quiet, good fellows, don’t make a sound.
Then the Buddha approached Poṭṭhapāda, who said to him, “Let the Blessed One come, sir!

entries.subject: since you

spans.text: It’s been a long time since you took the opportunity to come here.

entries.task_id: while poṭṭhapāda|took|a low seat and sat to one side
entries.description: while Poṭṭhapāda took a low seat and sat to one side
entries.subject: while Poṭṭhapāda
entries.object: a low seat and sat to one side

spans.text: The Buddha sat down on the seat spread out, while Poṭṭhapāda took a low seat and sat to one side.
The Buddha said to him, “Poṭṭhapāda, what were you sitting talking about just now?
What conversation was left unfinished?”
On the Cessation of Perception When he said this, the wanderer Poṭṭhapāda said to the Buddha, “Sir, leave aside what we were sitting talking about just now.
